Subject: Internal headcount reuse for senior SWE promotion (request)

Hi Markus / Laura,

Quick one: Nico (IC3 SWE, backend) handed in his notice last week and his role will be offboarded at the end of Sep. We have a strong internal candidate, Priya N., currently an IC2 SWE on infra -> she completed the T3->T4 readiness rubric last month and the hiring manager (me) and hiring committee recommend promoting and releveling her into the vacated headcount as a Senior SWE (T4) rather than running an external hire. This would be a headcount reuse + comp-band uplift request.

Why internal: Priya already owns two infra features we need to stabilize for Q4; promoting her reduces ramp risk and keeps tribal knowledge. We estimate a 10% comp uplift to meet band for T4 based on comp-band guide.

Asking for:
- approval to reuse the open headcount (IC3) for an internal promotion to Senior SWE (T4)
- approval for one-time comp uplift to move candidate to target T4 midpoint

Attachments: proposed offer PDF and comp-band memo.

If you need more detail I can share candidate notes and the audit trail from the hiring committee. Can we get a decision by EOD Friday (2025-08-15)?

Thanks,
Mike
Michael Grant
Staff Eng, Platform

Mike —

Thanks for the note and the docs. High-level reaction: I support prioritizing internal promotion when the candidate meets rubric and it preserves critical work. Two things I need before greenlight:
1) confirmation that reusing the IC3 slot does not violate any org-level hiring freezes for our EU region (I believe none active but confirm with finance).
2) precise budget impact (delta to total comp for FY25 and whether this converts to an uplift to the committed Dedicated budget).

Laura / Marissa — could one of you confirm (1) and (2)? If both check out, I can approve the headcount reuse and sign off on the comp uplift up to 12% (as an exception) pending final offer language.

Markus
